name: Spellbound Demonic Rune procs from damaging spells once per minute (#12432)
contract: #12432: Spellbound Demonic Rune (item 1414516) equips 23992, whose tooltip reads 'Your damaging spells have
a chance to increase your spell damage by $24025s1 for $24025d. Can only occur once per min.' 23992's single
proc effect is aura 42 triggering 24025 (aura 345, +80 spell power, duration index 1), but Spell.dbc gives
23992 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and the buff never
appeared. The fix adds the row: done negative magic spell hits, damage type, Spell.dbc ProcChance 100 and a
60 s cooldown. Frostbolt rank 1 (116) hits once with no periodic damage. With a 100% chance one Frostbolt
hit must apply 24025; after it expires a second hit inside the minute must not apply it again.
Player::ApplyEquipCooldown starts an on-equip proc cooldown when the item is equipped, so the first cast
